name: vows
title: Vows
description: A wedding theme set as an engraved invitation suite: a cotton card with a blind-embossed border on a sage envelope with a leaf-print liner, wide engraved capitals over an old-style italic, and the reply card — accepts with pleasure, declines with regret — tucked under its corner on every page.

tokens.--font-caps: the wide engraved capitals: the names on the invitation, page headings, programme titles, names of people, the menu and small headings
tokens.--font-text: running text: paragraphs, lists, tables and notes
tokens.--font-italic: the old-style italic: the invitation line, time and address, the reply card wording, programme times and places, roles and intros
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the engraved capitals
tokens.--tracking-name: letter spacing of the large names on the invitation and of page headings
tokens.--color-bg: the sage envelope: the page background
tokens.--color-text: text printed straight on the envelope: the welcome, the programme and people on the home page, the name in the footer
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the envelope: notes, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links on the envelope, the underline of links on a card, the tick drawn on a reply line, the bar beside a quotation and focus rings
tokens.--color-card: the cotton stock of the invitation, the reply card and every page sheet
tokens.--color-ink: engraver’s ink on a card: headings, text and links
tokens.--color-ink-soft: lighter ink on a card: the address, intros, notes, dates and post summaries
tokens.--color-liner: the leaf-print liner across the head of the page, and the background of selected text
tokens.--color-leaf: the leaves printed on the liner
tokens.--color-liner-ink: the site name, menu links, their current-page underline and focus rings on the liner; the colour of selected text
tokens.--color-emboss-light: the lit side of the blind-embossed border on a card
tokens.--color-emboss-shade: the shaded side of the blind-embossed border on a card
tokens.--color-rule: ruled lines on a card: the reply lines, table rows and the lines between posts
tokens.--color-shadow: the soft shadow a card casts on the envelope
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--measure: width of a page sheet and of the welcome text on the home page
tokens.--measure-wide: widest the liner, the home page and the footer grow
tokens.--invite: width of the invitation card on the home page
tokens.--time-col: width of the column of times in the programme
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the cards, code blocks and focus rings
tokens.--emboss-inset: how far inside the card edge the embossed border runs
tokens.--flap: depth of the point at the foot of the liner, the envelope flap
tokens.--tilt: how far the reply card is turned as it lies under the invitation
tokens.--tuck: how far the reply card slips up under the bottom of the card above it
tokens.--overhang: how far the reply card shows past the right edge of the card above it
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between items in a list
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between tags and pagination links
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, above and below the page
tokens.--space-5: large gap between sections and above the footer
